hints.title: Degrees of Freedom Dichotomy
hints.text: When k is greater than one, you can swap adjacent characters arbitrarily, achieving any permutation.

hints.title: Full Sorting When K Greater Than One
hints.text: If k is at least two, the lexicographically smallest string is simply the sorted string.

hints.title: Cyclic Rotation Minimization When K Equals One
hints.text: When k is one, you can only rotate the string cyclically. Take the lexicographical minimum across all n cyclic rotations.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Evaluating N rotations for K = 1, or O(N log N) sorting for K > 1.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph search across all reachable states explores factorial configurations unnecessarily.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: String rotation slices require O(N) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify bubble sort equivalence for K >= 2 and cyclic rotation for K = 1.
